stages.stage: grasp the teapot by its handle
stages.goal: The gripper closes on the teapot's handle at teapot.handle_center, with the teapot still upright at its spawn pose.

point_choice.pointer: grasp the teapot by its handle.point.teapot

stages.stage: carry the teapot upright over the mug
stages.goal: teapot.spout_tip ends up centered over mug.opening_center and lifted well above the rim, so the whole pot body clears the mug, with teapot.+up still pointing the way world.z points.
